clue.text: A group of gunners protecting unstable vessels

indicators.note: the gunners' letters are placed around the unstable piece, guarding it on either side

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British Army's gunners
mad here means mentally unstable

explanation.surface: A battery of artillerymen is guarding some shaky ships.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unstable' looks like it describes the vessels, but it supplies the letters held inside the gunners' abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: An armada is a fleet of warships, a collection of vessels.

clue.text: About time to change gauge

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for change goes round the word for time

parts.note: to change is to alter
taken as written

explanation.surface: It is nearly time to replace a measuring instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About time' looks like the stock phrase meaning 'at last'; 'About' is really the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An altimeter is an instrument that measures height, a kind of gauge on an aircraft.

clue.text: A chap from Paris and an artist

parts.note: a chap is a man
et is the French word for and

explanation.surface: A Parisian fellow and a painter are mentioned together.
explanation.definitionFit: Edouard Manet was a French painter, a forerunner of Impressionism.

clue.text: Record deliveries turn up

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
in cricket an over is a set of six deliveries from one bowler

explanation.surface: Some recorded deliveries finally arrive.
explanation.walkthrough: An OVER is six balls bowled in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn something up is to find it, which is to discover it.

clue.text: Academic Jack reversed vehicle that's in the way

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, abbreviated AB (able seaman)

indicators.note: the turned-round vehicle sits inside the abbreviation for the way

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way

indicators.note: the word for a vehicle is written backwards

parts.note: a cart is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A scholarly sailor backed his car into an obstruction on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversed' seems to describe a driver backing up; it turns the vehicle word backwards. 'that's' is a link, and Jack is a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstract means theoretical rather than practical, which is an academic sense.

clue.text: New lies the web disseminated from time to time

indicators.note: spread around, so the letters of the preceding words are scattered and reformed

explanation.surface: Fake news is being spread across the internet.
explanation.definitionFit: Between whiles is an idiom meaning at intervals, now and then.

clue.text: Unseated from high chair, so to speak

indicators.note: flags that the word for a high chair is to be pronounced, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a throne is a raised ceremonial chair

explanation.surface: Someone toppled from a lofty seat, as it were.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider who is unseated has been thrown from the saddle.

clue.text: Grand Duchess from a boundlessly unpleasant part of the world

indicators.note: without a bound or end, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: nasty means unpleasant
Asia is a continent

explanation.surface: A royal comes from some grim region of the globe.
explanation.walkthrough: NASTY loses its end letter Y to give NAST; 'from' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Anastasia was a Grand Duchess of Russia, daughter of the last Tsar.

clue.text: Fish — number caught by husband

parts.note: ten is a number
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A man has landed several fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A tench is a freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: A unit is deployed in the country

indicators.note: deployed means spread out into new positions, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A military unit is sent out into a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunisia is a country in North Africa.

clue.text: Behave provocatively — demand wallet, finally, and money

parts.note: to ask for something is to demand it

indicators.note: the last letter of the word is taken

parts.note: the rouble is the currency of Russia

explanation.surface: A mugger demands someone's wallet and then their cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To ask for trouble is an idiom for acting in a way likely to provoke problems.

clue.text: Prepare oneself to protect Queen and country

indicators.note: the training word surrounds the Queen, shielding her

parts.note: to train is to prepare oneself
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: Getting ready to defend monarch and nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrain means land or ground, a stretch of country.

clue.text: Saw essential oil applied to maiden

indicators.note: the oil is put next to the maiden, following it in the answer

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
otto, or attar, is an essential oil from rose petals

explanation.surface: A tool needed scented oil rubbed on a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like a verb or a tool; it is a noun meaning a saying. 'applied to' puts the oil after M.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or proverb, as is a motto.

clue.text: Stay alert and hang on to timer

parts.note: to keep is to hang on to
a watch is a timepiece

explanation.surface: Be vigilant and don't lose your clock.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep watch is to remain on guard and observant.

clue.text: How sword tapers is relevant

definitions.meaning: a sword narrows to its sharp tip
pertinent, directly concerned with the matter

explanation.definitionFit: A sword tapers to its tip, and the same phrase means pertinent or apposite.

clue.text: Broadcast live, tested horribly with drop of temperature

indicators.note: suggests something mangled, so these letters are jumbled
dropping a letter means the mixed letters lose one, so these words mark the loss

explanation.surface: A live programme was tried out badly when the heat fell.
explanation.walkthrough: LIVE and TESTED are rearranged with one T dropped: the letters make the answer plus T.
explanation.definitionFit: Televised means broadcast on television.

clue.text: In the existing circumstances, watering-hole lacks nothing

indicators.note: the word is missing a letter

parts.note: an oasis is a desert watering-hole
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: The desert spring has run completely dry.
explanation.definitionFit: As is means in the present condition, without changes.

clue.text: His advertisements are couched in high-flown language

definitions.text: His advertisements are couched in high-flown language

parts.words: His advertisements are couched in high-flown language
parts.note: high-flown literally means flown high: the ads are written in smoke from an aircraft

explanation.definitionFit: A skywriter traces words in smoke from a plane, an aerial advert.

clue.text: Draft treaty Public Record Office has to pass

parts.note: PRO is the abbreviation of Public Record Office
a col is a mountain pass

explanation.surface: The national archive must hand over a provisional agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A protocol is the preliminary draft of a treaty or agreement.

clue.text: Rob of bread

definitions.meaning: to rob someone, especially a drunk or sleeping person
a small loaf for one person

explanation.definitionFit: To roll someone is slang for robbing them, and a roll is a small piece of bread.

clue.text: After a short time, money is available for immediate use

indicators.note: the money comes after the brief time in the answer

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
the ready is slang for cash

explanation.surface: Shortly afterwards cash becomes available.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the ready' is British slang for cash.
explanation.definitionFit: At the ready means prepared and waiting to be used straight away.

clue.text: Lots of adults losing heart

indicators.note: the word loses its middle letters

parts.note: grown-ups are adults

explanation.surface: Many grown men lose their courage.
explanation.walkthrough: GROWN-UPS loses its middle pair, W and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Lots and groups are both sets of things gathered together, as in auction lots.

clue.text: Quick river reaches still water in port

parts.note: quick in its old sense means alive
a pool is still water

explanation.surface: A fast-flowing stream runs into a calm pond in a harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quick' means alive, as in 'the quick and the dead'.
explanation.definitionFit: Liverpool is a major port city in north-west England.

clue.text: Cover put on very large leisure facilities

indicators.note: in a down answer the cover sits on top of the next piece

parts.note: a lid is a cover
OS stands for outsize, very large

explanation.surface: A roof is placed over huge recreation centres.
explanation.definitionFit: Lidos are public open-air swimming pools, places for leisure.

clue.text: Dynasty's founder died, overwhelmed by disorderly rabble in retreat

indicators.note: the letter for died is engulfed by the crowd's letters
retreating means moving backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a rout is an old word for a disorderly crowd

explanation.surface: The royal line's founder perished, swamped by a fleeing mob.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in retreat' turns ROUT into TUOR, which closes round D.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry Tudor founded the Tudor dynasty of English monarchs, hence the surname as founder.

clue.text: Sum owed — girl coming out with it

parts.note: a deb (debutante) is a girl making her entry into society
taken as written

explanation.surface: Money is owed by a girl who's going out with it.
explanation.definitionFit: A debit is an amount owed, entered on the debtor side of an account.

clue.text: Upset, I'd burst out

indicators.note: out means in disarray here, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone distressed says they erupted.
explanation.definitionFit: To disturb someone is to upset them.

clue.text: Wine cask cut down by instrument

parts.note: sack is an old name for dry white wine like sherry

indicators.note: shortened, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: a butt is a large cask

explanation.surface: A wine barrel was chopped up by a tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A sackbut is an early form of trombone, a musical instrument.

clue.text: Avoid speed — it's chancy

indicators.note: chancy means risky and unpredictable, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Advice to motorists not to drive fast because it is risky.
explanation.definitionFit: To sidestep something is to dodge or avoid it.

clue.text: Horse-shoe right for horse entered in minor race

parts.note: a plate is a light horseshoe used for racing

explanation.surface: Swapping a horseshoe for a right one for a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A plater is an inferior racehorse that runs in plate or selling races.
